verification.precondition: A v2 workspace stores one immutable SurveyRuntimeArtifact bound to the containing run, exact accepted event bytes, and owning global journal transition.
verification.stimulus: Validate it, then independently corrupt the closed variant, run identity, transition, event, semantic revision, source digest, journal payload binding, reference kind, stored target, and inline-variant boundary.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Only an exact reference resolving to a structurally valid artifact whose five source fields join recomputed runtime-owned event and journal evidence validates.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: the v2 session admits only typed immutable SurveyRuntimeArtifact references
verification.forbiddenMutation: No self-asserted provenance field, malformed runtime variant, inline runtime variant, wrong kind, or unresolved runtime reference may enter authoring state.

behavior: the v2 session admits only typed immutable SurveyRuntimeArtifact references
